**Observation Log:**

- [FACT] The user is seeking a promotion to senior web developer at their work.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] A brag document is a document that highlights achievements, skills, and experience to showcase value to a potential employer.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] To write a brag document for promotion to senior web developer, focus on experience and skills as a web developer, as well as notable projects or accomplishments.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Start by making a list of relevant experience, skills, and accomplishments, including years of experience, certifications, degrees, and notable projects.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Organize information into sections that highlight strengths and skills as a web developer, such as front-end development, back-end development, and project management or team leadership.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Use specific examples and anecdotes to illustrate skills and accomplishments, such as describing a project where a particular programming language was used to solve a problem or improve website performance.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Keep the language positive and enthusiastic; the brag document should be a confident showcase of abilities, avoiding negative language or self-deprecating comments.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Proofread the document carefully to ensure it is free of typos and errors, as a well-written brag document makes a stronger impression.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] By following these tips, the user can create a brag document that will help them get promoted to senior web developer at their current job.
